QuestInfo.name: Precious Medicine
QuestInfo.0: Gold Richie has something else he wants to ask you...
QuestInfo.1: Gold Richie wants to support the Resistance in Edelstein by bringing them some necessary medicine. Since the Black Wings are keeping a tight watch, sending the complete medicine will be impossible. Therefore, only the ingredients will be sent. Defeat the #bMegrans#k that appear occasionally throughout Maple World and bring back #b10 #t4032804#s#k, which can be used to make medicine.
QuestInfo.2: You delivered the #b#t4032804#s#k to Gold Richie.

0.0: I have a job for you today. You should be more than capable of handling it... Will you do it for me?

yes.0: I am going to send precious medicine materials to the Resistance. These materials are normally difficult to obtain, but right now, they're in the season, so we're in luck.
yes.1: Do you know of a monster called Megran? The #b#t4032804##k that can be obtained from that monster is very rare and precious. According to rumor, it will restore the energy you have lost, give you a clear mind, and raise your power to the maximum limit... I even heard that it brings back your youth, but that could be an exaggeration...
yes.2: The Resistance will be able to defeat the Black Wings with the help of such great medicine, right? I need you to bring me #b10 #t4032804#s#k. Please hurry! We have to deliver it quickly so that the Black Wings will be driven out of Edelstein as soon as possible!

no.0: I guess it won't work out today. All right... Come see me later if you change your mind.

1.0: Were you able to find #t4032804#? To be honest, I wasn't expecting you to succeed, because it's so rare...

yes.0: How in the world did you find something so rare? You're better than I expected!

item.0: That's not enough. You need to bring me #b10 #t4032804#s#k.
